title: T08e — Demonstration of prerequisites and optional engine management on an owner-selected target
goal: Demonstration of prerequisites and optional engine management on an owner-selected target.
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: Demonstration of prerequisites and optional engine management on an owner-selected target
Check supported Node version, executable and non-interactive service environment before install/start/update; report missing or incompatible prerequisites
Provide explicit supported-platform Node installation/upgrade choices with reviewed ownership, permission and recovery; never silently replace a user-managed runtime
Support different and multiple engine/provider instances and endpoints together, including local engines and remote endpoints; Ollama is one adapter example, not the contract

Keep readiness probing separate from management ownership. Optional start-at-login/on-demand local engine management applies only to selected owned instances and configured policy; external services are not stopped or reconfigured
Bind engine adapters to declared capabilities/version support, endpoint identity, port/resource conflicts, credential privacy and recovery; a remote endpoint does not imply a local installation
Join prerequisite checks to service bootstrap/update and demonstrate configured optional engine startup on an explicitly selected target
validation: Meaningful cross-boundary regressions and required final CI
Explicit selected-target acceptance where service, install or real device behavior is required; static/unit passes do not substitute
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never change an unowned installation, service, engine or uncertain physical effect without explicit reconciliation

effort.estimate: 0.5 focused day plus the owner run
effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T08e of the step "Prerequisites: Node and optional management of multiple engines". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one.
